ui.title: Business Profile V2 Application
ui.subtitle: Complete the sections below to apply. You can save a draft and return at any time.

ui.title: Business Information
ui.subtitle: Tell us about your business. Details must match your registration documents.

ui.title: Business Details
ui.subtitle: Legal and registration information about your business

ui.label: Business PAN

errors.pattern: Enter a valid 10-character PAN, e.g. ABCDE1234F
errors.panEntityMismatch: PAN 4th character does not match the selected company type

ui.tooltip: 10-character PAN. 4th character must match the company type (C=Company, F=Firm/LLP, P=Proprietorship).

ui.label: GSTIN

errors.required: GSTIN is required for GST-registered businesses
errors.gstinPanMismatch: GSTIN characters 3–12 must match the Business PAN

ui.tooltip: 15-character GSTIN. First 2 digits are the state code; characters 3–12 must match Business PAN.

ui.label: CIN

errors.pattern: Enter a valid 21-character CIN, e.g. U12345MH2010PTC123456

ui.tooltip: 21-character Corporate Identification Number. Required for companies.

ui.label: LLPIN

errors.pattern: Enter a valid LLPIN, e.g. AAF-1234

ui.tooltip: LLP identification number. Hyphen is optional (AAF-1234 or AAF1234).

ui.label: Udyam Registration Number

errors.pattern: Enter a valid Udyam number, e.g. UDYAM-MH-04-0012345

ui.tooltip: 19-character MSME number including hyphens.

ui.label: State of Formation
ui.tooltip: State or UT in which the business was formed or incorporated.

ui.label: Date of Incorporation

errors.max: Date of incorporation cannot be in the future

ui.tooltip: Date on which the business was incorporated or registered.

ui.label: Year Established

errors.max: Year cannot be in the future
errors.beforeIncorporation: Year is earlier than the incorporation year. Please confirm.

ui.tooltip: Year in which the business started operations.

ui.label: Industry Type
ui.tooltip: Primary industry in which the business operates.

ui.label: Nature of Business
ui.tooltip: Primary nature of the business activity.

ui.label: Annual Revenue
ui.tooltip: Annual revenue or turnover of the business.

ui.label: Net Income

errors.exceedsRevenue: Net income is higher than annual revenue. Please confirm.

ui.tooltip: Net income of the business. Enter a negative value for a loss.

ui.label: Business PAN Card

errors.maxFiles: You can upload at most {maxFiles} file(s)

ui.uploadHint: PDF, JPG, PNG, up to {maxFileSizeMB} MB per file
ui.description: Upload a clear copy of the business PAN card.

ui.label: Cancelled Cheque

errors.maxFiles: You can upload at most {maxFiles} file(s)

ui.uploadHint: PDF, JPG, PNG, up to {maxFileSizeMB} MB per file
ui.description: Upload a cancelled cheque for this bank account.

ui.label: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
